reply_text:
*One merge-blocking finding* in `dedupe-imports` against `main`:

*`src/dedupe.js:2` — duplicates are compared by object identity, not contact ID.* `new Set(contacts)` keeps separate objects with the same `id`, so `mergeImports()` leaves overlapping contacts duplicated. This violates the documented first-seen-per-ID behavior (`README.md:5`).

*Recommended fix:* Track seen `contact.id` values and retain only the first object for each ID. Add a regression test using two distinct objects with the same ID, including across separate import lists.

Verified: all 4 existing tests pass, but `mergeImports([{id: 1}], [{id: 1}])` returns two contacts. The test “the same object is not repeated” only covers repeated references, missing the real overlap case.

No other findings. No files changed.
